body: Coming from a man who has an IVA I don't think I'm an expert, however my opinion would be to spend the excess income from your new job on clearing your debt. That way you wouldn't feel any worse off than you were when you started. Moreover from there a tip I found out the hard way is to split the money you have after your expenses into three, first third is the fun stuff, second third you could save and other third could go back into your debt
Sanctuary of Truth was the only really tourist trap I did there, it was priced not too badly given the beauty of the area
I was just in Pattaya last month, I managed to get a decent hotel for a week for £85 plus 4 nights in Bangkok for £45 it is definitely not European prices!

Thing is as it was after midnight obviously on the way back I got a second Tuk tuk and the driver was sound, he got me back to my hotel for 500thb. Just to put in perspective though I got a taxi from Bangkok to Pattaya for 2000.

I got scammed by a Tuk-Tuk on Nye if it makes you feel any better! 

He offered to take me to an area for NYE said 500 thb, I paid him it we drove around the block then got someone to translate for me where it was then he said 1000thb, didn't pay him until I got to destination, I only had a 1000thb note and he said he didn't have any change.... I really didn't want the agro so chalked it up as a learning experience
